scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply pillbug-staging --env staging --local
scripts.db:reset:local: ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -q :5173 && echo 'Stop the dev server before resetting the database.' && exit 1; rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npm run db:migrate:local
scripts.deploy:production: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production npx wrangler d1 migrations apply pillbug --env production --remote && npx wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.deploy:staging: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging npx wrangler d1 migrations apply pillbug-staging --env staging --remote && npx wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:preview: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging npx wrangler d1 migrations apply pillbug-staging --env staging --remote && npx wrangler versions upload --env staging
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
